controls: L / ZL / ◀ / Z: left flipper · R / ZR / ▶ / M: right flipper · Hold A, ▼ or Space and release: launch · Touch: left or right half of the screen · +: pause
launch_hint: Hold A / ▼ / Space (or touch) and release to launch
h_left: Left flipper: L, ZL, ◀ or Z
h_right: Right flipper: R, ZR, ▶ or M
h_launch: Plunger: hold A, ▼ or Space, then release
h_touch: Touch: hold the left or right half of the screen
